dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Welcome to The Rusty Rudder. Choose anything you want!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This place is...

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: As you can see, this is a bit of a dingy tavern. I'm the helmsman here, but you can call me Boss. Whatever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: You just tell me what you want to drink. I'll do my best to either make it myself, or find it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Of course, if you really want me to help find some new goods which aren't on the shelves, then you'll have to pay a little more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you wearing a divesuit?

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: I've called this here tavern The Rusty Rudder and, as the helmsman, I naturally have to dress accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: What's more, it makes it easier for me to dive into the water and fish out any drunk guests who fall in.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: If they insist on drowning, then let them at least drown in booze. Otherwise, it'd be bad for my tavern's reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: See you. You want something to drink, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to pay extra Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Mora? Heh, if you're only paying in Mora, then I can only sell you what's on the shelves. At most you could have some "good wine."

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: For things that aren't on the shelves, you need to trade something that's not in your wallet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wh—What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Heh, don't worry about it. Just choose what you want to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to see what you've got.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Please, take your pick. Though you'll have to make an offer if you want to buy the "good wine."

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't read too much into it. It's just a game, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Hey, you're quite something! I haven't met many customers who could beat me before.
